question:
Direction: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Gullible
solution:
The correct answer is "**cynical**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **Gullible means easily fooled or deceived**.(भोला)

 
 
• Example: I am so gullible, I would have believed him.
 
 
 
• **Cynical means distrustful or skeptical about human nature or motives**.(निंदक)
 
 
• Example: His speech was a cynical attempt to win votes.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "cynical" is the antonym of Gullible.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Credulous**" means too willing to believe or trust, similar to gullible.(विश्रंभी)
 
• "**Pliant**" means flexible or easily influenced, not opposite to gullible.(कोमल)
 
• "**Simple**" means uncomplicated or easy to understand, not opposite to gullible.(सरल)
